panels.headline: From Dream to Doctor
panels.body: For every late night, long shift, and quiet sacrifice that brought you here.
panels.art_direction: Deep navy blue, elegant medical graduation stationery with a clean white coat composition in the center, a stethoscope on the left, and a graduation cap on the right. Soft gold accents and generous margins.
panels.image_prompt: A premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork featuring a white coat with a stethoscope on the left and a graduation cap on the right, in a deep navy blue and white color palette with soft gold accents, set against a clean and simple background, with generous margins and a border-first stationery layout. Flat 2D full-bleed digital illustration. No readable text. No words, letters, handwriting, calligraphy, labels, signatures, or fake text. No people. No hands. No logos. No watermark. Avoid all-over repeating wallpaper patterns; use restrained hierarchy and negative space. Not a photo, not a physical paper card, not a folded card mockup, not a tabletop scene, not a product photograph.

panels.body: You kept going through exams, late nights, long shifts, and the sacrifices most people never saw. Today honors the discipline behind the white coat as much as the degree itself.

memory_citations: He pushed through years of exams, late nights, long shifts, and sacrifices.
The family is proud of his discipline, patience, heart, and dedication.
Use medical-school graduation symbols such as a white coat, stethoscope, anatomy sketch lines, ECG line, and graduation cap.
